scenes.text: Stars are not silent. They ring, and the ringing travels for millions of years.
scenes.art_prompt: a single bright star pulsing with faint concentric waves in deep space, cinematic

scenes.text: In 2019, a telescope caught a rhythm in a distant star that no model could explain.
scenes.art_prompt: a large observatory dome under a violet night sky, faint star trails

scenes.text: The pulse was steady, one beat every twelve minutes, far too regular for a natural star.
scenes.art_prompt: a clean waveform of a repeating pulse over a star field, scientific

scenes.text: Then the rhythm drifted, as if the source had moved. Stars do not simply wander mid-song.
scenes.art_prompt: a star shifting slightly against a fixed grid of background stars, subtle

scenes.text: Whatever it was kept perfect time for four years, then stopped. The sky where it sat is empty now.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty patch of sky with faint aurora light, quiet and unresolved

scenes.text: Follow Cosmic Wonders for the next one.
scenes.art_prompt: a vast aurora over a dark observatory, final wide shot
